import java.util.*;

public class Solver {
    int n, t;
    char[][] grid;
    int[][] sci;
    int[][] resc;
    int[][] inf_time;
    int[][][][] reach_time;
    int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static final int FLOW_N = 2 * 10 * 10 + 2;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
    int[][] cap, flow;
    int[] ptr, level, parent;

    void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(v);
        adj[v].add(u);
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }

    boolean bfs_level(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && level[v] == -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    boolean dfs_find(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        while (ptr[u] < adj[u].size()) {
            int v = adj[u].get(ptr[u]);
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && dfs_find(v, t)) {
                parent[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
            ptr[u]++;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs_level(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                parent[s] = 0;
                if (!dfs_find(s, t)) break;
                int add = INF;
                for (int v = t, u = parent[v]; v != s; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    add = Math.min(add, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = parent[v]; v != s; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    flow[u][v] += add;
                    flow[v][u] -= add;
                }
                ans += add;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    int node(int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        grid = new char[n][n];
        sci = new int[n][n];
        resc = new int[n][n];
        inf_time = new int[n][n];
        reach_time = new int[n][n][n][n];

        int bombI = -1, bombJ = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    grid[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    grid[i][j] = 'Z';
                    bombI = i;
                    bombJ = j;
                } else {
                    grid[i][j] = '.';
                    sci[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    resc[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize inf_time with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(inf_time[i], -1);
        }
        inf_time[bombI][bombJ] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{bombI, bombJ});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = i + di[d], nj = j + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && grid[ni][nj] == '.' && inf_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    inf_time[ni][nj] = inf_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize reach_time with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    Arrays.fill(reach_time[i][j][ii], -1);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] != '.') continue;
                reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q2.poll();
                    int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                    if (inf_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < inf_time[ii][jj]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int ni = ii + di[d], nj = jj + dj[d];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && grid[ni][nj] == '.'
                                    && (inf_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= inf_time[ni][nj])
                                    && reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                q2.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize flow network
        int totalNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        adj = new ArrayList[FLOW_N + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= FLOW_N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        cap = new int[FLOW_N + 1][FLOW_N + 1];
        flow = new int[FLOW_N + 1][FLOW_N + 1];
        ptr = new int[FLOW_N + 1];
        level = new int[FLOW_N + 1];
        parent = new int[FLOW_N + 1];

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = src + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_edge(src, node(i, j, false), sci[i][j]);
                }
                if (resc[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_edge(node(i, j, true), sink, resc[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        if (reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] >= 0 && reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            add_edge(node(i, j, false), node(ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Solver().solve();
    }
}
